info.title: Kyro Control API
info.description: Versioned P1 control plane, P2 signed catalogue/factory, and P3 durable planning, controlled agents, memory and verified candidate orchestration. Actor-scoped authority; model credentials are worker-only. Publishing is separate.

get.summary: Bounded-cardinality HTTP counters and latency histogram

200.description: Prometheus text exposition; labels are limited to a fixed HTTP method set and status class.

303.description: Redirect to the configured identity provider.
Redirect to the configured UI after setting session cookies.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous X-Next-Cursor response header.

get.description: Returns a safe job view. The creator may read their own reconciliation command with current budget or manage authority, without project read access; all other jobs require read authority. The store checks this exception atomically.

Private to the submitting actor and environment. Delta text is provisional. Complete includes effect output and usage when settled. Resuming reads durable fragments without another inference. Cursor is job UUID:generation:chunk index; Last-Event-ID overrides after. Sessions and project read permission are revalidated while streaming.

200.description: SSE delta events with cursor IDs and JSON {text}; complete event with status, error_code, optional effect_status, output {text,truncated}, and usage. Polling interval 250 ms.

JobCursor.name: before
JobCursor.description: Opaque base64url job sort cursor; it grants no access.

EffectCursor.name: before
EffectCursor.description: Effect UUID sort cursor; it grants no access.

InitialEventCursor.name: after
InitialEventCursor.description: Initial browser subscription cursor <project-uuid>:<sequence>; must match Last-Event-ID if both are supplied.

AgentVersion.name: If-Match
AgentVersion.description: Expected agent run version, independently of the AppSpec source revision.

Session.description: Opaque session information; CSRF token is returned only to the authenticated browser.

Organizations.description: Organizations and roles visible to this actor.

Memberships.description: Organization memberships visible to this actor.

Projects.description: Projects visible to this actor, ordered by updated_at descending then id ascending. The array body is retained; X-Next-Cursor is present only when another page exists. Pagination is not a snapshot across concurrent project updates.

X-Next-Cursor.description: URL-safe opaque cursor to pass as before for the next page.

ProjectSnapshot.description: Project snapshot with the strong current revision ETag.

CreatedProjectSnapshot.description: Created project snapshot with the initial revision ETag.

AppRevision.description: Immutable revision with its strong revision ETag.

ApplyChangesResult.description: Applied command and new immutable revision with its strong revision ETag.

Job.description: Safe actor-authorized job metadata; request bodies and reconciliation evidence are omitted.

Budget.description: Budget snapshot with strong configuration ETag.

Effects.description: Bounded effect page; model output is visible only to authorized readers.

Error.description: Stable generic error; response is never cacheable.

allow_unknown_provider_retention.description: Explicit acceptance of an unknown provider retention duration for conversation requests. Absent/false retains the historical refusal; known retention durations still obey max_retention_seconds.

accepted_unknown_retention_purposes.description: Explicit purpose-scoped acceptance of unknown provider retention. Absent/empty refuses unknown retention for agents; existing chat consent does not enable this field.

content.description: For conversation with a text_chat registry, use ChatInput. Other purposes retain their existing structured content.

provider_request_id.description: Optional opaque upstream receipt; absent on historical results.

output_mode.description: Historical registrations omit this field; text_chat streams visible text and constructs the final effect wrapper locally.

messages.description: Alternating user/assistant messages, ending with user. The server prepends its fixed system instruction.

content.description: At most 16,384 UTF-8 bytes; the aggregate wire context is also bounded.

TaskContract.description: Capabilities, protected criteria and shared invariants are derived or augmented by the server from signed admitted manifests. Supplied capability or criteria declarations confer no authority.

AgentRun.description: Authoritative server response only; no endpoint accepts run status, results, evidence, budget resets, provider configuration or authority. Creation currently requires development. Verified is a candidate and does not mean published.

AgentMeasurement.description: Provider usage may be unknown. Tariff estimates are not invoiced cost; effect_elapsed_ms is the persisted effect lifecycle, not pure model latency.

AgentCapabilities.description: Authenticated read-only runtime inventory. Configured tools confer no project permissions, budget or provider policy; mutations recheck these independently.
